purpose: positive control for the artefact-byte probes recorded in asset_manifest.json
claim_under_test: the HTTP 404s on every /tensor/reports/5559/figures/<name> endpoint mean the bytes are absent from the report store, not that the endpoint does not exist
source_record_note: GET /tensor/reports/<id> returns figures with an empty png_base64 field even when bytes are stored (observed on 5559 and on the report of this package, 14656); the byte endpoint is therefore the only channel that can decide presence.
conclusion: endpoint serves bytes when they exist -> the 5559 404s are a genuine absence of artefact bytes in the store, which is what the manifest's `unresolved` status for the six declared artefacts rests on
